docker_support.docker_evidence: Dockerfile present; official image ghcr.io/hatoo/oha

eval_notes: Modern Rust-based HTTP load generator with TUI visualization and HTTP/3 support (10k stars). Rate limiting and latency correction. Useful for testing HTTP API endpoints in network evaluation scenarios.

name: OpenStack Tacker
description: An OpenStack-based NFV Orchestrator service with built-in VNF Manager. Deploys and operates VNFs and CNFs on OpenStack and Kubernetes following ETSI MANO architecture.

docker_support.docker_evidence: Docker deployment through Kolla Ansible. Supports containerized VNF deployment on Kubernetes VIM. Pre-built container images available via OpenStack Kolla.

eval_notes: Full ETSI MANO implementation on OpenStack. Supports both VM-based VNFs and container-based CNFs. Good for testing NFV orchestration with OpenStack integration. Kolla-based Docker deployment.

name: P4 Behavioral Model (bmv2)
description: The reference P4 software switch. Takes JSON from P4 compiler and interprets it to implement packet-processing behavior. Includes simple_switch, simple_switch_grpc, and psa_switch targets.

docker_support.docker_evidence: Official Docker image p4lang/behavioral-model on Docker Hub. Multiple Dockerfiles: Dockerfile and Dockerfile.noPI. Community image cslev/p4-bmv2-docker also available.

eval_notes: Reference P4 switch for developing and testing P4 data planes. Not production-grade but essential for P4 development and education. Docker images enable quick lab setup for programmable data plane testing.

name: Polycube
description: eBPF/XDP-based software framework for fast network services running in Linux kernel. Includes Kubernetes CNI plugin.

docker_support.docker_evidence: Dockerfile present in root directory. .dockerignore file included. pcn-k8s CNI plugin for Kubernetes container networking.

eval_notes: eBPF-based network function platform. Useful for evals involving programmable network functions and Kubernetes CNI debugging.

name: pyang
description: YANG validator, transformer, and code generator written in Python. The reference implementation for YANG model validation. Supports YANG 1.0 (RFC 6020) and YANG 1.1 (RFC 7950). Extensible via plugins including yang2dsdl, UML, and tree output.

docker_support.docker_evidence: hellt/pyang-docker provides Alpine and PyPy-based Dockerfiles; damianoneill/pyang also provides container-based solution with all dependencies

eval_notes: Most widely used YANG validator in the Python ecosystem. Lint plugin for IETF/BBF compliance checking. Docker images available from community. Essential for YANG model CI/CD pipelines. Industry standard YANG validator. 563 stars. Used in OpenConfig Models-CI pipeline. The de-facto standard YANG validator. Essential foundational tool. Extensible plugin system supports code generation (Python bindings via pyangbind, UML diagrams, tree views, DSDL schemas). Most YANG Docker images bundle pyang.

name: rtpengine
description: RTP and media proxy for SIP/VoIP platforms. Handles NAT traversal, transcoding, and call recording.

docker_support.docker_evidence: Dockerfile present in repository root directory.

eval_notes: Key component for VoIP infrastructure. Docker support enables containerized media plane testing for SIP/RTP evals.

name: Ryu SDN Framework
description: A component-based software defined networking framework written in Python. Supports OpenFlow 1.0-1.5, Netconf, OF-config, and Nicira Extensions. Well-defined API for creating network management applications.

docker_support.docker_evidence: Official Docker image osrg/ryu published to Docker Hub. Community Dockerfile (WillFantom/Ryu-Docker) uses Python 3.8 and alpine for a smaller image.

eval_notes: NOTE: Ryu is no longer actively maintained; OpenStack's os-ken is the maintained fork. Still widely used as the basis for many SDN lab setups and research projects. Python-based making it easy to extend for agentic eval scenarios.

name: SD-RAN ran-simulator
description: RAN simulator from ONF's SD-RAN project. Simulates CU/DU nodes and RU cells via O-RAN E2AP standard with a YAML-based topology model.

docker_support.docker_evidence: Docker containers available on Docker Hub. Deployed as part of SDRAN-in-a-Box (RiaB). Note: source code is read-only; functional binaries only available as Docker containers.

eval_notes: O-RAN E2AP compliant simulator with gRPC API for runtime topology changes. Simulates dynamic RAN environment. Useful for O-RAN/RIC integration evals. Part of ONF SD-RAN ecosystem.

name: srsRAN_4G-docker
description: srsRAN 4G Docker-based implementation. Compose file includes optional second UE using default user_db.csv from srsEPC.

docker_support.docker_evidence: Docker compose with optional second UE. Uses default user_db.csv from srsEPC. Multi-UE support in Docker.

eval_notes: Multi-UE Docker setup for srsRAN 4G. Simple to deploy. Good for basic LTE evals with multiple UE scenarios.

name: UPG-VPP
description: GTP-U User Plane Gateway based on VPP (Vector Packet Processing). High-performance 5G UPF implementation.

docker_support.docker_evidence: To build a Docker image that contains UPG along with the base VPP, run: make image. Multiple references to dockerized environment in development setup documentation.

eval_notes: High-performance UPF with Docker build support. Good for user plane configuration and GTP tunnel management evals.

name: Vegeta
description: Versatile HTTP load testing tool and Go library designed to drill HTTP services with constant request rate, avoiding Coordinated Omission issues.

docker_support.docker_evidence: Dockerfile present; community Docker images: peter-evans/vegeta-docker, dannykansas/vegeta-docker

eval_notes: HTTP load testing with constant request rate and accurate latency measurement (25k+ stars). CLI and library usage. Excellent for benchmarking API endpoints in 5G core network evaluation scenarios.

name: Gradiant 5G Images
description: Dockerfiles for building Cloud-Native Network Function (CNF) container images for the Gradiant Lab5G platform, focused on 5G and evolvable to 6G.

docker_support.docker_evidence: Repository of Dockerfiles for Docker Images for the Lab5G platform; CNF container images for 5G network functions

eval_notes: Source Dockerfiles for Gradiant's 5G container images. Useful if you need to customize or rebuild specific NF images. Pairs with 5g-charts for deployment.

name: hey
description: Lightweight HTTP load generator and ApacheBench replacement supporting HTTP/2, concurrent workers, and custom headers.

docker_support.docker_evidence: Dockerfile present with multi-stage build for Linux executable

eval_notes: Simple, widely-used HTTP load generator (20k stars). Tiny footprint, easy to containerize. Good for quick API performance checks in evaluation environments.

name: Intel FlexRAN
description: Intel's 4G/5G baseband PHY reference design for Xeon processors with Docker image build support and O-RAN fronthaul interface.

docker_support.docker_evidence: docker build will just copy the pre-built binaries to docker image. After the docker build finishes, docker image with oran-release tag will be generated

eval_notes: High-star Intel reference implementation for O-RAN L1 PHY. Docker images for O-RAN release builds. Useful for testing O-DU low-level integration but requires specific Intel hardware.

name: ncclient
description: Python library for NETCONF clients. Facilitates client-side scripting and application development around the NETCONF protocol (RFC 6241). Supports vendor extensions for Juniper, Cisco, Huawei, Nokia, and others.

docker_support.docker_evidence: Commonly included in network automation Docker images; used as backend in netpalm

eval_notes: The de-facto standard Python NETCONF client library. Foundation for most Python-based NETCONF testing tools. Not Docker-native itself but trivially containerizable.

name: Netopeer (v1)
description: First generation NETCONF Protocol Toolset by CESNET. Includes NETCONF server and CLI client with Docker support. Predecessor to Netopeer2.

docker_support.docker_evidence: This repository has a Dockerfile that can be used to create a container that builds netopeer-server and starts the service.

eval_notes: Legacy first-gen NETCONF server. Superseded by Netopeer2 but still functional. Use Netopeer2 for new evals. Legacy NETCONF server. Prefer Netopeer2 for new projects. Still referenced in older test setups and Ansible NETCONF testing repos.

name: UnifyAir Core
description: High-performance 5G Core Network Functions implementation in Rust based on 3GPP Release 17. Async-first architecture built on Tokio with AMF (Omnipath), UPF (DataWarp), and SMF (InfiniSync).

docker_support.docker_evidence: docker-bake.hcl and .dockerignore files present in repository structure

eval_notes: Only Rust-based 5G core. Early development (AMF implemented, UPF/SMF planned). Interesting for performance benchmarking against C/Go alternatives. AI capabilities planned.

name: yang2swagger
description: YANG to Swagger (OpenAPI Specification) generator producing RESTCONF-compliant API definitions. Handles enums, leafrefs, groupings, and augmentations with model inheritance optimization.

docker_support.docker_evidence: Docker run command documented: docker run -it -v $(pwd):. yang2swagger <arguments>

eval_notes: Primary tool for generating OpenAPI/Swagger specs from YANG models. Useful for building REST API documentation and client/server stubs from YANG-defined interfaces. Docker support makes it easy to integrate into CI/CD.

name: yanger
description: Extensible YANG validator written in Erlang by the creator of pyang. Faster than pyang for large module sets. Supports plugins for Swagger/OpenAPI generation.

docker_support.docker_evidence: Bundled in broadbandforum/yangtools Docker image alongside pyang and yanglint

eval_notes: Erlang-based YANG validator. Complementary to pyang for cross-validation of YANG models. Less commonly used but provides independent validation perspective. Same author as pyang but implemented in Erlang for better performance. Includes swagger plugin for OpenAPI generation from YANG. Less widely adopted than pyang but faster for CI validation pipelines.
